newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia June crude palm oil output down 0.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia June crude palm oil output down 0.6 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output dropped 0.60 percent to 787,807 tonnes in June from 792,540 in May and against 721,544 in June 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Tuesday.
June palm oil exports were 612,124 tonnes against 633,507 in May and 581,372 in June 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 2.36 percent to 603,099 tonnes in June from 589,187 in May and 562,412 in June 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak fell 9.17 percent to 184,708 tonnes in June from 203,353 in May and against 159,132 in June last year.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 5.18 percent to 100,903 tonnes in June from 95,931 in May and against 90,337 in June 1996.
Tan Lee Lee -- Kuala Lumpur commodities -(603-275 -6834)
